reports.headline: Last Round at the Storehouse
reports.body: A bell has been hung over the trapdoor of the storehouse {dir} of the village {dist}. {name} says anyone who rings it is entered into the final round, all or nothing, and that the house has never once lost.

reports.headline: Ring the Bell, Take the Bet
reports.body: The elders have tried to burn the storehouse {dir} of here {dist} twice and it would not catch. The bell over the trapdoor waits. {name} says whoever rings it had better be very lucky.
